about_the_game:
Fish ‘n Ships is a cozy 2D fishing game!

Fish!
There are plenty of fish in the sea, and you can catch them all. Charging casts and manipulating your hook and line allows you to try and catch any fish you see in the water. But watch out, not all fish want to be caught!

Sell!
Bring back your haul to the port and sell your fish at the market. Keep track of which fish are in demand so you can stay ahead of the market. It's all about supply and demand!

Upgrade!
Spend money to upgrade your hook, boat, and more. Upgrades let you cast further, fish deeper, and catch bigger. You can also travel to different fishing spots and find even more fish!
